subject: Film & Cinema
title: Writing the Twist Ending
description: A fast breakdown of Writing the Twist Ending for builders.

hook.text: 'I see dead people.' Six years later, audiences were still debating The Sixth Sense.

buildup.text: A great twist recontextualizes everything the audience has already seen.

discovery.text: The twist must be surprising yet inevitable — clues must be hidden in plain sight.

twist.text: Bad twists cheat the audience. Good twists reward them for paying attention.

climax.text: Films like Gone Girl and Parasite prove twists still have enormous power.

punchline.text: The best twist was always there. You just missed it.

quiz.question: What makes a twist ending work?
options: It's surprising but supported by hidden clues throughout
